neighbours.label: 'power'/'ability'/'authority' as a capacity or legal authority to do something ('the power to X')
fire: The new agency was given the power to fine polluters.
Only the Senate holds the power to confirm judges.
Parliament granted the mayor powers of arrest during the crisis.
The union lacks the power to call a strike without a vote.
Under the treaty, the commission has the authority to inspect factories.
Governors were stripped of the power to pardon prisoners.
The court retains the ability to review any such decision.
Voters have the right to recall an elected official.
quiet: The new turbine will generate power for nearby farms.
Only the north grid has enough power for the whole city.
The storm knocked out power across the region during the crisis.
The union hall lost power when the strike began.
Under the treaty, the commission must inspect factories each year.
Governors were praised for pardoning several prisoners.
The court reviewed the decision last spring.
Voters lined up early to recall an elected official.

notes: Card: ' power', ' to', ' of', ' ability' in 'the power to regulate'. Output suppresses ability/capability tokens. Near misses keep 'power' in its physical/electrical sense or drop the capacity frame.
